items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the story 'Mijbil the Otter', and answer.

"The moment the bathroom door opened, the young otter shot past my legs and leapt into the half-filled tub. He rolled, dived and surfaced, slapping the water with his paws, and sent a fountain over the floor. When I tried to lift him out he slipped through my fingers like soap and plunged back in, chattering with delight."

Answer the following:
(i) "Slipped through my fingers like soap" is an example of …  (a) a metaphor  (b) alliteration  (c) a simile  (d) personification
(ii) Why did the narrator find it hard to lift the otter out?
(iii) Which word shows the otter was happy?  (a) delight  (b) plunged  (c) slapping  (d) surfaced
(iv) Which trait of Mijbil does this passage recall?  (a) His laziness  (b) His anger  (c) His love of water and playful nature  (d) His fear of water
items.answer: (i) (c) a simile (ii) He was slippery and kept plunging back into the water. (iii) (a) delight (iv) (c) His love of water and playful nature
items.markingKey: (i) (c) a simile (ii) He was slippery and kept plunging back into the water. (iii) (a) delight (iv) (c) His love of water and playful nature (1 mark each, 4 marks.)
